data.name: Sampath
data.gender_notes: Sampath is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who possesses wealth, abundance, and prosperity in all aspects of life. The name Sampath carries the meaning “Abundance, Wealth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil. Parents who choose Sampath usually hope their child will grow to embody abundance, wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the attainment of inner wealth, wisdom, and enlightenment
data.etymology: Sampath belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Abundance, Wealth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sampath total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Sampath" holds a significant cultural meaning in Hinduism as it symbolizes a person who is blessed with wealth, abundance, and prosperity in all aspects of life. It is believed that people with this name are favored by gods, leading to an overall better standard of living and happiness. In Hindu literature and folklore, there are many characters and deities with this name, emphasizing its positive connotation.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, "Sampath" responds to the inner calling for spiritual wealth and abundance. It signifies the attainment of inner riches and a contented mind, even in the absence of material possessions. The name invites one to explore the path of inner joy and to realize that true prosperity lies in the realization of the self, rather than in external possessions. It embodies the spirit of Dhanam or charity, which is a practice highly revered in Hinduism, as one's true measure of wealth is the generosity and kindness with which they share their possessions with others. "Sampath" is a name that encourages beings to strive for both material and spiritual prosperity, leading to a fulfilling and soul-enriching life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Sampath, meaning 'abundance' or 'wealth', symbolizes the spiritual richness and fulfillment derived from inner peace, wisdom, and the blessings of the divine. It is a reminder of the ultimate wealth that transcends worldly possessions.

vedic_reference.note: Sampath is a common name in Hindu mythology and appears in various texts such as the Mahabharata and the Ramayana. It is also a common name among Hindus in India and other parts of the world.

historical_references.reference: Sampath was a popular name during the Chola Empire (9th to 13th century) in Tamil Nadu, India. Several inscriptions and temple records from this period mention the name Sampath.

Sampath is also a common name among the Vaishnavite Hindus, especially among those who follow the Bhagavata Purana. According to this text, Lord Vishnu appeared to King Janamejaya in the form of Sampath to impart the knowledge of the Sama Veda.
historical_references.time_period: Ancient India, probably before 5th century CE
historical_references.context: Bhagavata Purana, Vaishnavite Hindus, Sama Veda

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Sampath continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.
